What Types of Junk Can We Remove?

From the everyday to the extraordinary, 1-800-GOT-JUNK? handles a wide variety of items. Here’s a quick rundown of what’s on the menu in Kansas City.

Common Household Items

  • Old sofas, mattresses, and box springs
  • Appliances (refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers)
  • Electronics (TVs, computers, printers)
  • Furniture, carpets, and rugs
  • Yard waste (branches, gravel, soil)

Construction & Renovation Debris

  • Drywall, plaster, and insulation
  • Concrete, bricks, and tiles
  • Scrap wood and lumber
  • Leftover paint cans (if properly sealed)

Specialty Items

  • Hot tubs, spa equipment, and pools
  • Large commercial equipment (e.g., office chairs, industrial shelving)
  • Hazardous‑look items (most are not accepted; the team will advise you)

When in doubt, give the team a quick call. They’ll let you know if an item is accepted and suggest alternatives for anything that can’t be hauled.

How the Process Works – Step by Step

One of the biggest reasons people love 1-800-GOT-JUNK? is the simplicity of the process. Below is the typical flow from the moment you decide you need help to the final clean‑up.

1. Request a Quote

Visit the website or call the local Kansas City office. A friendly representative will ask a few quick questions about the type and volume of junk you have. In most cases, you’ll receive a price estimate within minutes.

2. Schedule Your Pickup

Pick a date and time that works with your calendar. 1-800-GOT-JUNK? offers same‑day service when possible, especially for urgent clean‑outs.

3. The Team Arrives

On the scheduled day, a uniformed crew shows up with a fully equipped truck. They’ll walk you through the plan, answer any last‑minute questions, and start loading the junk. You don’t need to lift a thing—just point and they’ll do the heavy lifting.

4. Load, Haul, and Dispose

The team loads everything onto the truck, secures it, and drives to the appropriate facilities. As mentioned earlier, most items are recycled or donated, reducing your environmental footprint.

5. Payment & Receipt

Payment is straightforward—cash, credit, or debit works. You’ll receive a receipt that includes a breakdown of what was recycled, donated, or sent to landfill, giving you peace of mind that the job was done responsibly.

Pricing Insights for Kansas City Residents

Pricing is based on volume, not weight, which makes it easy to understand. A typical one‑bedroom clean‑out in Kansas City might run between $150‑$250, while larger projects (like a full‑house remodel) can range from $500‑$1,200. The quote you receive will be all‑inclusive—no surprise fees for mileage, fuel, or disposal.

Tips to Keep Costs Low

  • Separate recyclables: If you have clean cardboard, paper, or metal, set them aside. The crew can handle them faster, often reducing your overall volume.
  • Donate before the pickup: Items in good condition can be dropped off at local charities, which frees up space and may lower the price.
  • Plan your pickup: Consolidate smaller jobs into one larger appointment to avoid multiple trips.

Service Area Coverage in the Metro

1-800-GOT-JUNK? serves the entire Kansas City metropolitan area, including neighborhoods like Brookside, Westport, the Country Club Plaza, and the surrounding suburbs of Overland Park, Olathe, and Lenexa. No matter where you are, the team can usually reach you within a few business days.
